title: Projection after coordinate extension
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a subset of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $z$ be a function from the $|J|$ positions to $\mathbb F_2$. Extending $z$ to all $n$ coordinates by placing its values on $J$ and zero elsewhere, then projecting onto $J$, recovers $z$.
